@gideon.sato Draft Hartford incident summary for Mateo's procurement team, from the #inc-vtg-hartford log:

Hartford gate kiosks incident, Aug 3, 2026 (ticket INC-4821)
- First report: 10:42 AM. Gate kiosks offline at the Hartford plant; both inbound lanes showed a white screen after badge scan.
- Kiosk 1 back: 11:03 AM. Trailer 8836 checked in and visible to dispatch.
- Both lanes confirmed working: 11:07 AM.
- Open item: status-page access for Mateo's account was still being chased after the lanes recovered. Kiosk 2 was kept powered on for reconnect attempts.

Note: the log gives times without a time zone, so please confirm the zone before sending.
